crossRefs.note: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,
He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.
His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.
The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.
Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.

translations.web: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.
translations.bsb: Their descendants are established around them, and their offspring before their eyes.
translations.kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
translations.asv: Their seed is established with them in their sight, And their offspring before their eyes.
